'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Michael Erisman DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Erisman]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

* '''Deck name:''' Tuskens...
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
